caveats: Times and memory are observations of one machine, software stack and campaign; nothing here is a pass/fail, and no ratio is a claim beyond this campaign.
Headline time is work time (wall minus startup); startup is shown apart. Estimator and postprocessing are inside work time because Palace users cannot switch them off.
Memory is the sum of per-rank peak RSS (shared pages counted per rank); PSS and sacct are cross-checks.
Palace phases are max-of-rows (an upper bound on the slowest rank); rank 0 shown beside.
Nominal Krylov tolerances mean different things in the two codes; iterative codes are compared only at equal achieved error.
Accuracy is against the named converged reference; unresolved errors are shown as such; Palace errors carry the definition offset δ; same-code error is solver error, not accuracy.
Each code runs at its own defaults except the listed pins; structural differences are listed per case, never removed.
Excluded records: everything in the failures table. Medians over passing repeats; n < 3 shown.
Ratios across Slurm jobs are labelled "different nodes"; node class is observed, not controlled.
